answerCalculationForPromo requires BOTH amount AND a calc-intent keyword. The CALC_INTENT_KEYWORDS list is intentionally broad; the substring check 'get' will match inside common words like 'target' or 'together' — probably fine since it also requires an extractable amount, but worth noting for future test data.

The Knowledge-Hub-standalone branch (activePromoId==null) still auto-replies without any confirm — consistent with iter29 spec, but note: it also NEVER triggers handoff for free text when there's no KB match — it silently falls through to the always-handoff line 1030 saySystem('Great — connecting you to a human agent now.') + handoffToHuman. Not part of this iter's bug fix scope but flagging for context: outside the promo flow, free text still triggers instant handoff. Confirm this is desired product behavior.

rca of the issue: Fixed correctly by main agent: (a) active-promo branch of sendMessage now first calls answerCalculationForPromo(findPromoById(activePromoId), userText) — using the RAW KB entry (not the derived display shape) so bonus_percent/turnover_multiplier/free_spin_tiers are available. This returns a full calc reply for 'if i deposit rm50 how many turnover…' → MYR 6,790.00. (b) The former action:'instant_handoff' keyword group ('problem/issue/not working') now sets promoHandoffPrompt with a friendlier prompt instead of directly firing handoffToHuman. (c) No-match fallback also sets promoHandoffPrompt with 'I'm not sure how to answer that…' instead of silent instant handoff. (d) promoConfirmHandoffYes reads prompt.context (the customer's original text) so the handoff payload is 'Promotions: <title> — <original text>'. All four fix legs verified E2E.
